turns.t: Morning, doctor! Lovely day, isn't it? I almost cycled over, but the knee said no, so the bus it was. ~
Very sensible. How is the knee, since we sent you for the scan?
Oh, it's behaving, mostly. I've got the report here, if you want it. Though I don't understand a word of it. ~
Let me have it. Ah, yes. I've got the scan results up on screen too. ~
Go on, then, break it to me. ~
The scan is consistent with a small tear in the meniscus, which is the cartilage cushion in the knee, on the inner side.
I thought it might be. I did my knee in at Sunday football, I told you. Twisted it in the mud, my own fault.
And it's been how long since the twist? ~
Six weeks on Sunday. It was a daft tackle, I should know better at my age. ~
Football's a young man's game. Tell me about your tablets, so I can check against the record.
Ibuprofen, 400 mg, when it twinges. And paracetamol, 1 gram, when the ibuprofen's not enough. I only use them after the match.
That's sensible, and don't take more than that. ~
No, no, I read the packet. My wife reads it to me anyway, every time. ~
Good for her. How would you say it's been day to day, is it holding you back? ~
I can walk the dog, no bother. I just won't play for a while. The lads are gutted, mind. ~
It's early days. A small tear like this often settles with rest and strengthening exercises, without an operation. ~
That's a relief. I thought you were going to say surgery. ~
Not at this stage, no. I'd like you to do the physiotherapy exercises I'll print out, daily, and avoid twisting on that leg.
Can I swim? ~
Swimming's fine, except breaststroke, which twists the knee. Front crawl is okay. ~
Right. I'm more of a doggy paddle man. ~
That'll do. Keep the knee moving, and ice it for ten minutes after exercise if it's sore. ~
Does that actually work? ~
It can help the swelling, and it's harmless. ~
Fair enough. What about when I can play again? ~
Let's see how it feels in six weeks. I'd like to see you then to review it.
Six weeks. Right. Put it in the diary, would you? ~
Reception will do it on your way out. ~
Marvellous. Thanks, doc. ~
Mind how you go. ~

clinical_actions.description: Do physiotherapy exercises daily and avoid twisting; ice after exercise
